title: A Level Negative One Rookie Just Walked Into The Witch's Trap . . . (highlight)
caption:
Overgeared episode 1: a level negative one player stumbles into a level 150 temple and meets Yura the Blood Witch. Full recap is on our page 👉 link in the comments

#overgeared #anime #animerecap #animeexplained #fyp

segments.say: A level two hundred thirty Blood Witch just showed up, and the rookie caught in the middle is level *negative* one.
Grid is level negative one, and he just wandered into a level one hundred fifty *dungeon*.
Inside, hooded cultists are chanting a cursed *ritual*.
Before he can run, a warrior named Dorian grabs *him*.
Dorian says the earl's daughter Irene was *kidnapped*.
Grid says no. But the system hands him an S-rank quest *anyway*.
The cultists spot them, and now there is no *escape*.
Dorian cuts through them like it is *nothing*.
Then she appears. Yura the Blood Witch, level two hundred thirty, and she wants *him*.
He swings again and again, but he cannot land a single *hit* on her.
Her curses are brutal. Only an ancient family *ring* can block them.
Dorian knows he cannot win. That was never a *fair* fight.
So he turns to Grid, and tells him to take Irene and *run*.
Does Grid run, or does he stay? Episode 1 is on our page.
